name: Threads Builder
description: Builds and maintains real Thread notes from Outlook email activity -- the real Hermes cron job behind this is email-delta-capture (every 30 minutes), running the email-thread-capture Skill.

steps.name: Fetch Emails
steps.description: Pulls new Outlook email since the last capture watermark (.second-brain/email_capture_state.json).

steps.name: Thread Match & Merge
steps.description: Resolves each email to its real running Thread by subject/participants -- creates a new Thread note only when none matches.

steps.name: Build Messages & People
steps.description: Creates a dated Message note per email and a Person note per new sender, deduplicated against existing People (recursive glob across Customers/ and Partners/).

steps.name: Capture Attachments
steps.description: Saves each email's real attachments into the Thread's own files/ folder.
